name: R3_sbt_ubt_strips
description: Reference 3 (Guglielmo 16 Nov 2026): R2 (full SBT + UBT) + the V0 rule (candidate traced back as a neutral, any hit within 5 cm + 25 mrad x distance, time window opened 3 ns early) + silicon strips in the MS7 magnet: 3 layers in the 50 cm iron at the entrance, the middle and 10 cm before the end (29.39, 29.59, 29.79 m), each 8 stations of 30 x 30 cm on the inner part of both return-yoke legs (|x| 0.75-1.35 m, |y| < 0.3 m; the legs span |x| 0.70-1.75 m): 82 % of the selected V0 interaction points, at most 34 MHz per station; superimposed on the iron and field. 17 Nov 2026 (Guglielmo): V0 rule only for p_vis < 20 GeV; strip window 3 ns (+-1.5 ns) instead of 25 ns.
